course_summary:
ISEN 689 / ISEN 489 | Human Factors in Healthcare
Instructor: Farzan Sasangohar | sasangohar@tamu.edu
Meets: Tue/Thu 2:20-3:35 PM | ETB 1013
Grading: Research report (individual) [40%], Homework assignments (individual) [30%], Reflections (individual) [20%], Practicum (team) [10%] — A: 90-100%, B: 80-89%, C: 70-79%, D: 60-69%, F: 59% and lower
Topics: Design for X (DfX) methodology, healthcare human-systems engineering, human factors and ergonomics (HFE), human factors engineering methods, scoping review, narrative review, Artificial Intelligence (AI) text generators, natural language processing tools, chatbots, audio generators, computer code generators, video generators, image generators, healthcare ecosystem design, Human Factors applications, critical and emergent issues in healthcare, patient safety, design problems, operational problems, HFE solutions, HFE principles, research project, analysis, design, implementation, evaluation of healthcare systems, emerging topics related to HF/E in healthcare, implications, consequences, productivity, safety, wellness, satisfaction in healthcare settings, teamwork, communication skills, original study, research paper, healthcare applications, case study, background research, standard citation styles, editing, reviewing, creating drafts, revising drafts
Tools: Canvas, ChatGPT, spelling and grammar checkers
Prerequisites: ISEN 330
